assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7240d07f55ab0c2.text: we generally think of simple robots that clean the floor in our home or build a car in a factory.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7240d07f55ab0c2.text: But how close are we to having robots that are like people?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7240d07f55ab0c2.zh: 但我们离拥有像人一样的机器人还有多远？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7240d07f55ab0c2.text: Well, we already have some robots that look like people,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7240d07f55ab0c2.zh: 其实，已经有一些外形像人的机器人了，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7240d07f55ab0c2.text: and technology is developing more every day.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7240d07f55ab0c2.zh: 而且技术每天都在不断发展。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7240d07f55ab0c2.text: Robots weren't used very much in the past, since they were always really expensive.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7240d07f55ab0c2.zh: 过去机器人使用得并不多，因为它们总是非常昂贵。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7240d07f55ab0c2.text: But because they're cheaper now, they're being used in new and interesting ways.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_7240d07f55ab0c2.zh: 但由于它们现在更便宜了，人们正以新颖有趣的方式使用它们。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be0293627b45487.text: robots have been used in factories for years.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be0293627b45487.zh: 机器人多年来一直被用于工厂。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be0293627b45487.text: Singapore and Korea are among the top five countries in the world with factory robots,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be0293627b45487.zh: 新加坡和韩国是世界上工厂机器人数量最多的五个国家之一，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_be0293627b45487.text: and Japan has robots that serve food in some cafes.

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f4fd30eb049fafd.text: some restaurants are testing robots which work in the kitchen and cook food,

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f4fd30eb049fafd.text: robots are being developed to work on farms and help grow food.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f4fd30eb049fafd.zh: 人们也正在研制能在农场工作、帮助种植粮食的机器人。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f4fd30eb049fafd.text: They can pick fruit, for example, or look at plant health.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_f4fd30eb049fafd.zh: 例如，它们可采摘水果或检查植物健康状况。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_451c87667164fd8.text: But what about robots that look after or help people?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_451c87667164fd8.zh: 但那些照料或帮助人的机器人呢？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_451c87667164fd8.text: Well, many companies are developing robots to help people who have a disability or people who can't always do housework or care for themselves easily.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_451c87667164fd8.zh: 很多公司也在开发机器人，以帮助残障人士，或帮助那些不总能轻松做家务、照料自己的人。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_451c87667164fd8.text: They might need help from robots that can carry things around the house or deliver medicine on time.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_451c87667164fd8.zh: 他们可能需要能在家中搬运物品或按时送药的机器人帮助。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_451c87667164fd8.text: These types of robots are becoming less expensive.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_451c87667164fd8.zh: 这类机器人的价格正变得更低。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_451c87667164fd8.text: Having a robot means people are able to stay in their own homes.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_451c87667164fd8.zh: 拥有机器人意味着人们能够留在自己家中生活。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3694bbfdb4bf891.text: And you also said robots could be doctors or librarians.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3694bbfdb4bf891.zh: 你刚才还说机器人可以当医生或图书管理员。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3694bbfdb4bf891.text: Does that mean I shouldn't study for a degree in library studies because a robot is going to take all the librarian's jobs?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3694bbfdb4bf891.zh: 那是不是意味着我不该读图书馆学学位，因为机器人会抢走图书管理员的所有工作？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3694bbfdb4bf891.text: robots only help with the boring parts of being a librarian.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3694bbfdb4bf891.zh: 机器人只是帮助完成图书管理员工作中枯燥的部分。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3694bbfdb4bf891.text: They use barcodes to look for books on the shelves or put books in the right place.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_3694bbfdb4bf891.zh: 它们用条形码在书架上找书，或把书放回正确的位置。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.text: So do people have a much better quality of life thanks to these new types of robots?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.zh: 那么，这些新型机器人会让人们的生活质量大幅提高吗？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.text: Yes, but at this time, it's too expensive to have robots at home that can pick people up or feed them.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.zh: 会，不过目前能在家里抱起人或给人喂饭的机器人太贵了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.text: Also, when robots were used in care homes,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.zh: 另外，当机器人被用于护理院时，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.text: the nurses found that the robots didn't save time.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.zh: 护士发现机器人并没有节省时间。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.text: The robots had to be moved and watched.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.zh: 机器人需要被移动和看护。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.text: The nurses spent time looking after the robots, and so they had less time to look after the people.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.zh: 护士要花时间照看机器人，因此照看人的时间反而更少了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.text: They stopped using the robots due to the lost time.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.zh: 由于耽误时间，他们停止使用这些机器人。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.text: What are some other ways that robots are used?
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.zh: 机器人还有哪些其他用途？

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.text: These days, people use robots for science research, to repair equipment in the ocean,
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.zh: 如今，人们用机器人进行科学研究、维修海中的设备，

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.text: and as assistance to doctors and librarians.
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_549f0114eaf9dae.zh: 也让它们协助医生和图书管理员。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_dc467576e5e3eaa.zh: 第二，科学家发现计算机改变了我们记忆的信息类型。这些变化有利也有弊。一个弊端是，人们现在似乎会忘记事实，尤其是在知道信息会被保存在文件中的情况下。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_545951a01a6e420.zh: 其次，科学家发现电脑改变了我们记住的信息类型。这些变化有利也有弊。缺点是，人们似乎会忘记事实，尤其是知道信息会保存在文件里时。优点则是，他们会记住事实的位置，也就是在哪里能找到它。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_545951a01a6e420.text: scientists told university students some facts and Also where the facts were saved in a file Most of the students couldn't remember the facts, but they were able to remember the files and the location of the facts
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_545951a01a6e420.zh: 科学家向大学生讲了一些事实，并告诉他们这些事实存在哪个文件里。大多数学生记不住事实本身，但能记住文件以及事实所在的位置。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_545951a01a6e420.text: In conclusion it seems that computers are not making us stupid, but they are making us lazy
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_545951a01a6e420.zh: 总之，电脑似乎没有让我们变笨，却让我们变懒了。

assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_545951a01a6e420.text: Scientists believe that we are spending time remembering where and how we can find things But we're not trying to remember the information itself anymore
assets/alpha/audio/ALPHA_545951a01a6e420.zh: 科学家认为，我们花时间记住在哪里、怎样找到东西，却不再努力记住信息本身。
